findings.label: Incomplete ownership validation for storage files
findings.description: The worker validates database record ownership but doesn't verify the storage file path belongs to the same user, allowing potential access to other users' files.

findings.label: Insecure file path resolution
findings.description: Path traversal check uses relative_to() without ensuring the base directory is absolute and resolved first, which could be bypassed with crafted paths.

findings.label: Runtime errors not categorized
findings.description: Missing optional dependencies (pypdf, python-docx) raise RuntimeError that propagates as a generic processing error instead of being handled explicitly.

findings.label: Queue re-enqueue loses retry context
findings.description: When jobs are re-enqueued on failure, the retry_count and delay metadata are added to a new payload rather than preserving the original job's context, potentially causing incorrect retry logic.
